experiments.title: One-week demand validation spike for the GeoNerd wedge
experiments.hypothesis: If five target UK accountancy practices are shown a scan-based AI visibility report and asked to commit at a tested price, then at least two will commit at >=£19/mo, because the pain is felt and the report is actionable.
experiments.central_assumption: Owner-partners of 1-20-staff UK accountancy practices will pay at least £19/month for a monthly AI visibility digest after seeing a free scan.
experiments.kill_condition: Zero of five interviewed practices make any concrete commitment at any price, or the dominant reaction is 'interesting but I would not pay' after the iterate week, or interviewed practices already pay for a satisfying incumbent.
experiments.decision_rule: Proceed iff >=2 of 5 practices commit at >=£19/mo AND >=25% of scan completers submit an email AND at least one non-network recruitment channel produces a conversation. Iterate once if exactly 1 commitment, or the chosen price is consistently £9, or email capture works but no conversations happen. Stop after the PoC if 0 of 5 commit.

experiments.title: Willingness-to-pay test for an 'all reasonable steps' evidence tool
experiments.hypothesis: If ten UK employers with 10-100 staff and no dedicated HR system are shown a concrete 'reasonable steps' evidence pack and then asked to commit at £12/month, then at least three will commit, because the 30 October 2026 duty creates a live compliance need that free guidance alone does not operationalise.
experiments.central_assumption: UK SME employers with 10-100 staff and no dedicated HR system will pay at least £12/month for a low-cost 'all reasonable steps' evidence tool rather than rely on free Acas/EHRC templates and the HR software they already have.
experiments.kill_condition: Zero of ten employers make any concrete commitment, or a majority say free Acas/EHRC guidance and existing HR software already suffice, or legal-advice concerns block the proposition.
experiments.decision_rule: Proceed iff >=3 of 10 employers commit at >=£12/mo AND at least one non-network recruitment channel yields >=5 conversations. Iterate once if 1-2 commit or the price settles consistently at <=£8/mo. Stop if 0 of 10 commit or the dominant reaction is that free guidance/HR software is enough.
